subject: reasoning
question:
Monit starts from point A and drives 43 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 54 km, turns left and drives 58 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 67 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 15 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Monit starts from point A and drives 43 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 54 km, turns left and drives 58 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 67 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 15 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd023ac5ec9ebf63b3ba980a579f4917edca2ca3d98cde7bd59fc2eb8f28197a.png] 

Thus, he should drive 13 km to the west in order to reach point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
